biggest_catch: Fieldwork's official site confirms you get an incentive per study but states no dollar amount — the catalog's '$300 per study' is unsupported by official terms.
catches: Official Fieldwork join page (http://www.fieldwork.com/Join/) confirms incentives ('what you will receive as an incentive') but names no dollar amount.
Incentives are typically sent within 2 weeks of participation — not instant.
You must pass screening to confirm qualification; not everyone who registers gets studies.
Participation is an independent-contractor relationship, not employment — no steady work or income.
In-person facilities exist in ~12 US cities; most others only qualify for phone/online studies.

eligibility: Open to anyone who registers; each study has its own demographic screening. In-person studies require proximity to one of Fieldwork's facilities (Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dallas, Denver, Fort Lee NJ, Los Angeles, San Francisco, Orange County CA, Minneapolis, Phoenix, Seattle); others are eligible for phone/online studies via the national database.

steps: If you were to try it: register at fieldwork.com/Join/ and complete your profile.
You will receive study opportunity information by email or phone; pass the screening.
Complete the study (in person, phone, or online).
Receive the incentive — typically within 2 weeks — but the amount is not stated in official terms, so this route is unverified.
